newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH FIRM BAUMA ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: POLISH FIRM BAUMA ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED.

text.p: Investors registered for 3,903,205 shares of construction materials maker Bauma SA, compared with an offer of 1.2 million, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.
The statement said investors had their bids reduced by 69.26 percent.
Before the issue Bauma, which aims to enter the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse, had 130,421 shares approved for public trade.
In 1995 the company made a net profit of 418,000 zlotys on sales of 15.4 million zlotys.
It expects profits to rise to 1.5 million zlotys on sales of 14 million in 1996, and to 2.1 million zlotys on sales of 19.6 million in 1997. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
